usage: 粉紅色 is used to name a color, specifically pink.
It acts as a noun when describing colors of objects or clothes.
In sentences, 粉紅色 can be a subject, object, or used after a verb to describe the color of something.
You can combine 粉紅色 with nouns like 衫 (clothes) or 褲 (pants) to specify the color of these items.
粉紅色 can also be combined with adjectives or used in comparisons to talk about shades or preferences.
